A well-established mixed-billing practice in a leafy suburb just 15 minutes south of Brisbane is seeking a dedicated and compassionate  General Practitioner . The practice has a strong reputation for providing high-quality care to a diverse patient base, from routine check-ups to complex treatments like iron infusions. 

 The centre features 12 spacious consultation rooms, a four-bed treatment room, and comfortable waiting areas. Practitioners benefit from on-site and undercover parking, as well as the convenience of an attached chemist and on-site pathology. On-site allied health services, including a podiatrist and a visiting urologist, are also available. The practice offers excellent support with an experienced nursing team, who assist with care plans and treatment room services, and a skilled administrative team led by a dedicated practice manager. 

 This is a registrar training practice, with supervisor opportunities available. Practitioners are offered clinical autonomy and flexible working arrangements. The practice supports professional growth through a partnership with the RACGP, which simplifies the process of achieving and recording CPD requirements. Free in-house CPD opportunities and discounted registration for industry events are also available. Support is also provided for practitioners with special interests in skin, aesthetics, and occupational medicine. 

 Located in  Holland Park , a tranquil yet connected Southside community, the area is characterised by charming timber houses and quiet streets. It features excellent local amenities, including parks and a vibrant retail strip with cafes and shops, making it an attractive location for families and professionals.   Apply Now
